Name: Jen's Gothic Farmhouse
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

A gothic retexture for your farmhouse! The main file has built in compatibility with Alternative Textures!

- It is seasonal, however spring, summer, and fall share the same texture.
- Configurable porch overlay, so it doesn't look like you're standing on top of the rails.
- All three house upgrades are the same. This might change in a later update, I don't know yet.

[size=4][b]Please do not ask me about making other buildings. I will make them as I get time and motivation.[/b][/size]

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

- [b]Replace[/b]: Replace the base farmhouse texture. (True, False) Defaults True
- [b]Skin[/b]: Add the gothic farmhouse texture as a skin, allowing it to be selected with Alternative Textures and Robin's build menu. (True, False) Defaults True
- [b]Porch Overlay[/b]: Disable this if you decide to use another farmhouse texture while keeping this one installed. (True, False) Defaults True

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (and optionally [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]).
- Copy [CP] Jen's Gothic Farmhouse into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
